subject.title: fix(ui): render pinned sessions headerless like sidebar nav entries

question: Should pinned sessions become a permanently visible, non-collapsible nav-style section even for users with a previously persisted collapsed pinned state?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but whether removing this existing sidebar interaction is the desired product behavior requires UI-owner intent rather than a purely technical review.

options.title: Adopt non-collapsible pinned shortcuts
options.body: Approve the nav-style treatment and accept that prior pinned-collapse state is no longer honored.

options.title: Retain collapsibility
options.body: Keep the pinned header or introduce a separately designed collapse control so existing user interaction semantics remain available.

recommendation.title: Adopt non-collapsible pinned shortcuts
recommendation.body: Approve the nav-style treatment and accept that prior pinned-collapse state is no longer honored.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this person directly to the proposed sidebar interaction model, though current-main area history was not independently available.
